name: requireganizer
description: Turn a one-line idea into requirements, contracts and tests you approve item by item, then give your coding agent the spec to build against, over MCP.

ai_api_key.title: AI API key
ai_api_key.description: Key for the AI endpoint, for Requireganizer's own AI. Empty means the person reviews alone.

ai_base_url.title: AI endpoint
ai_base_url.description: An OpenAI-compatible Responses API. Empty means OpenRouter.

ai_model.title: Writer model
ai_model.description: The model Requireganizer writes with. Empty means its default model.

ai_reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
ai_reviewer_model.description: The model that reviews each submission. Empty means no automatic review.
